high_level_description: This image depicts a quiet urban scene with a prominent statue of a person on horseback at the center. The statue is mounted on a large, square pedestal, which appears to be made of stone or concrete. The base of the pedestal has some inscriptions, though they are not clearly legible in the image. The statue is situated in a roundabout or intersection, surrounded by a metal fence that separates it from the road. The road itself is wide and appears to be relatively empty, with only a few vehicles visible in the distance.
